row.name: Kidversity LLC, DBA It's a Small World Nursery School

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The preschool classrooms have stopped using the sinks in the bathrooms because they clog when in use for too long. In the toddler and older infant rooms, the portable sinks are also not functioning. The sinks have not been in use for over a week.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Outdoor Activities: When entering from outside, the toddlers and preschool classrooms did not wash their hands. Additionally, before eating, the older infants, toddler room, and Pre-K classes also did not wash their hands. In the toddler room, hands were not washed after diaper changes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Outdoor Activities (26 TAC §746.3417(4))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Outdoor Activities: It was observed that in the older infants', toddlers', and preschool rooms, caregivers did not wash their hands after coming in from outside, after diaper changing, and before serving food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Outdoor Activities (26 TAC §746.3415(9))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: The caregivers in the Preschool room reported having 18 children in care, but upon counting, it was determined that there were actually 20 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the investigation inspection, a caregiver was observed to be alone with eight children for three to four minutes. The ratio for one caregiver for this age group is 1:4.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During the investigation, a caregiver was observed using their cell phone while supervising children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Four out of six personnel files lacked the required 24 hours of training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Four out of eight children files lacked current immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Four of eight personnel files lacked CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Four of eight personnel files lacked first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Six out of eight infant feeding instructions were not completed for the month of April.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: An infant was observed swaddled in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was observed outside of the classroom walking to the restroom alone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: An infant room had 8 children present with one caregiver. The specified age of a 12 month to 17 month room is five infants to one caregiver. This classroom was over ratio by three children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing pad in the toddler room had a large tear which made the changing pad absorbent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Assisting a Child with Toileting: A caregiver did not wash their hands after assisting children with the toilet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Assisting a Child with Toileting (26 TAC §746.3415(5))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Five children were observed in bucket seats not buckled in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: Operation lacked a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that children under the age of two were watching television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: During the course of the investigation inspection children were observed in highchairs (restrictive devices) which were being used as a form of discipline due to the children throwing blocks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Two caregivers were observed changing diapers. They did not wash the children's hands afterwards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required: There was not an extra person in the building during nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: RECITE: Two out of four children's records evaluated lacked an updated shot record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Two out of four personnel files evaluated completed CPR training online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of four children's records evaluated lacked an updated shot record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The boys bathroom was observed dirty with dead insects and trash on the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Pinching, Shaking, or Biting: Based on information gathered, a caregiver has pinched multiple children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information gathered during the investigation, a caregiver failed to use good judgment when she kicked children's mats during nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Garbage in the boy's bathroom was overflowing from the trash can and onto the floor.    Note: This was corrected when the director took the trash out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The Director failed to utilize tools provided by Child Care Regulation to assist in evaluation of the operation classrooms, required posting, and staff files, resulting in non-compliance at the time of review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Child must not go more than 3 hours: The Pre-K children were not given snack until being instructed to do so by licensing, which was after 4:00pm.    Note: This was corrected when the children were given snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Child must not go more than 3 hours (26 TAC §746.3301(d))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was observed caring for twenty-three children. The specified age group was three years old; therefore the caregiver was over child/caregiver ratio by eight children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: Sink in the Toddler classroom is not working as the water does not come out when faucet is turned to "on".
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Caregiver failed to maintain ratio in the prek classroom for a short period of time. The specified age group for the prek classroom,  at this time, is 15 for one caregiver and one caregiver took four children to the restroom leaving the other caregiver with 20 children in one classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Two children were observed being unsupervised in the restroom playing in the sink with soap and water and paper towels. These two children were unsupervised for 8  minutes and  neither teacher acknowledged the children missing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: Sink in the Toddler classroom is not working as the water does not come out when faucet is turned to "on".
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Prek Classroom had two rugs, green road rug and  alphabet rug, having frayed edges posing a tripping hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: Posted activity plan in the Prek Classroom was outdated as the plan posted is for the week on January 18-21, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Directors and teacher did not exercise good judgment by allowing two children to be unsupervised playing with water  in the restroom for 8 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: Teachers did not account for two children in their classroom as the two children played in the restroom unsupervised for 8 minutes and neither teacher acknowledged the children missing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Through information received with this investigation, it was determined that prohibited punishment was used when on caregiver pushed a child to the ground aggressively.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: Caregiver did not interact positively with one child's behavior as the child pushed the caregiver and the caregiver pushed the child back aggressively making the child fall to the ground. This was witnessed by another caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(7))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined the caregiver did not demonstrate good judgement when she aggressively pushed a child to the floor because the child pushed the caregiver; this was witnessed by another caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
